attemptOrdinal.description: Current attempt ordinal on the Task.

runId.description: Active Run id for this Task.

updatedAt.description: Last status change on the Task (proxy for the Run view).

description:
Run-shaped compatibility projection of a WorkTask's current attempt —
the umbrella's `add-work-management` design §"Run-consumer
compatibility projection". Shape-compatible with the pre-`WorkTask`
`GET /api/v1/runs/{runId}` response and includes the
authoritative `taskId` field. 404 when the requested attempt
has been fenced by a replacement (per the design's
"Superseded attempt returns 404" scenario).
